title: The postcard run, iv
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: The last postcard of the run. A return address, for the first time. Wood writes back. The strip shows the mailbox flag up, then down. Never the reply.

panels.composition: A postcard, writing side. Her hand, calmer: three lines and, at the bottom, an address. A street in a city. A number. The first return address in six postcards.

image.prompt: brush-pen over blue pencil, xerox grain, stark black spotting, close-up of a postcard's writing side with three short lines of handwriting and for the first time a return address written at the bottom
image.notes: The address is reserved; draw it as a plausible European street, unreadable.

panels.composition: WOOD at the desk. An envelope. Writing. The strip shows the back of his head and the pen moving. BARNABY asleep.

panels.composition: The roadside mailbox. The envelope going in. The flag going up.

image.prompt: brush-pen over blue pencil, xerox grain, stark black spotting, a young man putting an envelope into a roadside mailbox and raising its red flag

panels.composition: The mailbox. The flag down. Empty. Nobody in the panel. The dog's nose at the frame edge.

image.prompt: brush-pen over blue pencil, xerox grain, stark black spotting, a roadside mailbox with its flag down, empty, a dog's nose just entering the frame, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; xerox; black and white

notes: The reply, never shown. Flag up, flag down. The arc ends.
